DIAGNOSIS READY: Extrahepatic Biliary Obstruction (likely due to Cholangiocarcinoma or Pancreatic Head Cancer).

The combination of painless jaundice, dark urine, pale stools, and significant weight loss in a 50-year-old smoker strongly suggests a malignancy obstructing the common bile duct.
